Works offline

Download your maps ahead of time and TribeSentry keeps going with no reception at all — on the trail, in the mountains, abroad with roaming off.

Crash detection, free

If your phone detects what looks like a car crash, your group is alerted automatically with your location. Not a paid tier. Not an add-on.

We don't sell location

Your location history is deleted automatically after seven days, and it is never sold to anyone. That is the whole business model.

What's in it

Everything you'd expect from a family locator, plus the things that only matter once you're actually out of range.

Live map

Everyone in the group, in real time, on one map — with who's moving and who's stopped.

Places

Get an alert when someone arrives at or leaves home, school, or work.

Groups, not just families

Your location isn't the product

Location sharing only works if you trust where the data goes. So here is exactly where it goes.

The short version:
  • We don't sell your location data. Not aggregated, not anonymised, not to anyone.
  • History is deleted after 7 days, automatically, by a scheduled job — not on request.
  • Sharing is yours to switch off at any moment, and your group is told it's off rather than shown a stale pin.
  • Delete your account from inside the app, and the location, history, and group membership go with it.

The full detail — every field collected, every processor, and your rights under GDPR and CCPA — is in the privacy policy.
